recalled_knowledge.item: Structure and ordering of Anand-Fitzpatrick-Haxton Table 1: L1-L4 scalar/pseudoscalar products, L5-L20 the 4x4 grid {V,T,A,T-gamma5}_chi x {V,T,A,T-gamma5}_N in the order L5 = VV, L6 = VT, L7 = VA, L8 = V T~, L9 = TV, L10 = TT, L11 = TA, L12 = T T~, L13 = AV, L14 = AT, L15 = AA, L16 = A T~, L17 = T~V, L18 = T~T, L19 = T~A, L20 = T~T~
recalled_knowledge.reliability: likely (confirmed a posteriori: reproduces LZ's five constant pairs and its ten-member s/v list)

recalled_knowledge.item: Nonrelativistic reductions of the Dirac bilinears (scalar, pseudoscalar, vector, axial, tensor, tensor-gamma5) with 2m normalisation; Gordon identity
Anand response coefficient functions R_M, R_Sigma'', R_Sigma', R_Delta, R_Phi'', R_Phi''M, R_Phi~' incl. the combination (c12 - q^2/m_N^2 c15) in Sigma' and Phi''
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Anand et al. 2014 eqs. 38-40 / Fitzpatrick et al. 2013 eq. 40 (as also recalled by P057)

recalled_knowledge.item: Tensor mass scale m_M = m_N in the LZ/Anand normalisation

recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Anand et al. 2014 Table 1; confirmed by P003/P012 against LZ Fig. 1

recalled_knowledge.item: Vector identity (S_N.q)(S_chi.(q x v_perp))/m_N^2 = (q^2/m_N^2) O12 + O15 (the operator Fitzpatrick et al. call O16)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: derived here from the decomposition of S_N in {q, v_perp, q x v_perp}
recalled_knowledge.reliability: certain (derivation); WimPyDD's x5400 suppression for the same-sign combination confirms the cancellation

recalled_knowledge.item: Hellinger and KL divergence definitions; Gaussian log-likelihood-ratio asymptotics for N_3sigma

failed_or_abandoned: First compute run omitted the 1/m_v^2 factor in the Anand-to-WimPyDD coefficient closures: shapes unaffected, absolute rates 3.67e9 (= m_v^4) too large relative to P057's cache; caught by the L8s/O10s = 4 and L20s/O6s = 16 checks; cache cleared and all 44 fresh spectra recomputed (239 s).
ZeroDivisionError in the Gaussian N_3sigma for identical (aliased) pdfs (L1s vs O1s etc.); guarded to return infinity.

Expectation that L12 (q^4 v^2 Sigma'' + q^4 Phi~') would be O6-like up to a slowly varying <v_perp^2> factor: WimPyDD's Phi~' response makes it a separate class (H = 0.30 to L20s); the expectation was dropped.

LZ's count of 293 distinguishable spectra could not be reproduced from its stated reductions (40 -> 23 Lagrangian entries x 11 masses = 253 leaves 40 for the inelastic set, which has 60-69 physical entries); noted, not resolved.
Ratio diagnostics over 20-400 keV were dominated by Sigma'' nodes; restricted to 20-270 keV with a 1e-3-of-maximum mask.
